Recognizable educational chess silhouettes, NOT emoji or flat pictograms. EXACT regular 3x3 grid, same scale, centered within each cell, at least 12 percent empty padding on all sides of EACH cell, no touching or overlap, complete silhouettes. Completely transparent background with real alpha, including all cell gutters; no background, no checkerboard transparency preview, no floor, no panels, no frames, no captions, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. No humans. Soft studio shading inside each icon only. Intended to crop cleanly by uniform CSS sprite cells.
